common_name: Terminal Ediacaran cone-in-cone biomineralized calcite tube

chronoseries.note: One chronospecies. The contrast formalized here is against the coarser 104.2 µm funnel rung of the same body (slot 1252), not against a second Nama age.

phenomenon_scale.label: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Cloudina hartmannae (2.4 µm, detail scale)

paleobiology.radiometric_constraint: Penny et al. 2014 date an ash immediately above the Omkyk Member at 547.32 ± 0.31 Ma. The slot age remains the assigned 549 Ma Nama horizon.

scale_contrast_versus_predecessor_rung.predecessor_meaning: Cone-in-cone funnel / primordium repeat. That slot's script does not define Du, a, or b; none of its numbers are copied.
scale_contrast_versus_predecessor_rung.pattern_axis: Wall-normal organic lamellae, not the along-tube funnel rhythm
scale_contrast_versus_predecessor_rung.successor_not_modeled: Yang et al. 2020 Zuunia lamellae mostly < 1 µm, with 80–200 nm fibrils

equations.kinetics: Schnakenberg 1979: f = a - u + u^2 v, g = b - u^2 v
equations.diffusion: du/dt = f + Du u_yy, dv/dt = g + Dv v_yy on a periodic wall-normal interval
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (Dv fu + Du gv) / (2 Du Dv)
equations.growth_rate: sigma(k) = 0.5 * (tr(M) + sqrt(tr(M)^2 - 4 det(M))), M = J - k^2 D
equations.turing_conditions: fu + gv < 0, det(J) > 0, Dv fu + Du gv > 0, (Dv fu + Du gv)^2 > 4 Du Dv det(J)

parameters.note: Du and Dv are derived from a, b, the ratio, and lambda_c. They are not free aesthetic constants and they are not the textbook pair a=0.1, b=0.9.

empirical_claims: Germs 1972 named Cloudina hartmannae from the Nama Group.
Grant 1990: each shell layer is 8 to 50 µm thick, a slightly flaring cone, originally a rigid CaCO3-impregnated organic-rich material, likely high-Mg calcite.

Yang et al. 2020: organic lamellae in Namibian Cloudina are 0.5–5 µm thick, up to eight per wall layer, partly embedded in diagenetic calcite spar. The authors argue the tubes were originally organic and favour an annelid-grade affinity.
Penny et al. 2014: in situ Cloudina hartmannae reefs in the Omkyk Member, Nama Group.
Turing 1952 and Schnakenberg 1979 supply the dispersion relation and the kinetics. Neither paper measured Cloudina.
2.397 µm is the assigned detail-scale wavelength. It lies inside the Yang band. It is not a published pigment-ocellus measurement.

reported_in_source: Nama Group Cloudina hartmannae cone-in-cone tubes at the terminal Ediacaran
Yang et al. 2020 Namibian organic lamellae 0.5–5 µm, up to eight per layer
reconstructed_in_script: Jacobian entries and Du, Dv chosen so lambda_c = 2.397 µm and the fastest periodic mode is that wavelength
Noise-seeded nonlinear integration, equal-diffusion control, autocatalysis ablation, diffusivity-scale sweep
Goodness-of-fit between analytical and numerical growth rates
transfer_boundary: Mapping a reaction-diffusion lamella wavelength onto an Ediacaran tube wall is a morphospace hypothesis
Cnidarian-grade (Grant) versus annelid-grade (Yang) affinity is contested and is not decided here
The species-card image is a 100 µm-scale picture; the 2.4 µm field is a reconstruction at a finer rung
does_not_claim: That Cloudina hartmannae had eyes, ocelli, or a measured pigment stripe at 2.397 µm
That the species card or the Corumbá slab is a Nama Group lamella micrograph
That the Wikimedia life restoration is a fossil specimen
